title: Saving with Description and Part Number empty shows both required-field errors together and sends no request
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. DevTools Network open, filtered on parts/create. Pick Category before typing Cost (known pre-existing: Cost first sends calculate-sell-price with an empty category → 400 "Invalid UUID" / "Failed to calculate sell price.").
custom_steps:
1. On /parts/inventory click New Inventory Part, leave Description and Part Number empty, pick a Category, type Cost 10.00 and click Save.
  2. Wait 10 seconds without touching the fields.
  3. Type three spaces in Description and three spaces in Part Number, then click Save.
  4. Type Description "QA S7 required" and click Save.
  5. Type Part Number "QA-S7-REQ-{run}" and click Save.
  6. Cleanup: open the new part and click Delete Part (button_delete_part).
custom_expected:
1. "Description is a required field" under Description and "Part number is a required field" under Part Number show at the same time; the dialog stays open; no POST /api/inventory/parts/create appears in the Network tab.
  2. Both inline errors are still shown (they stay until corrected).
  3. The same two errors show; still no create request is sent.
  4. The Description error clears; "Part number is a required field" stays; no request is sent.
  5. One POST /api/inventory/parts/create → 201; the dialog closes and QA-S7-REQ-{run} appears on the list.
  6. The part is deleted at once (no confirmation), the dialog closes and the list reloads without it.
